composition.intent: 兩套完整造型同時可見：淺色西外配深褲，深色西外配淺褲。袖口動作僅是自然活動，不當成教學主張。
composition.viewing_question: 不用字幕，能否一眼看出兩套上下身明暗配色互換？
composition.method: reuse previously tested equal full-person parallel presentation for this specific visible color relationship
composition.novelty_limit: editorial application of existing format, not new camera language or an audience-performance claim
composition.transition: none; both looks visible throughout with no internal cut; later switches default0.75s
composition.comparison_limit: 6s simultaneous view vs original11.25s sequential view differs in duration and layout; not a controlled performance test

metadata.ffmpeg_version: 7.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev built with gcc 14.2.0 (Rev1, Built by MSYS2 project)

scan.note: Technical signals only. Continuous visual review and user approval remain separate.

source_timing: output frame n reads frame n from each original source; no forced gesture synchronization
sampled_visual_review: 25 whole-film samples plus native first frame inspected. Comparable apparent head/waist/shoe scale, full-person and hand/bag bounds retained in samples; color reversal visible simultaneously. No continuous-playback or audience-comprehension claim.
